messages.author: 20a857807016d58a
messages.subject: ggplot2 devel version installation: error
parts:
Hi,

I would like to install the devel version of ggplot2 (since it fixes
the axis-label-placement issue addressed here:
http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/browse_thread/thread/0946ae817c95e2e8)

I found https://gist.github.com/1150934 and tried to follow it:

install.packages('devtools', type="source")
install.packages(c("RColorBrewer", "stringr", "dichromat", "munsell",
"plyr", "colorspace"), type="source)
library(devtools)
dev_mode(TRUE)
install_github("scales")
install_github("ggplot2", "hadley", "develop")

On executing the second last line, I obtain:

Error: /private/var/folders/5r/fpc7qzk55ll71t9j8l9d1d_00000gn/T/
RtmpqCbLAI/Rbuild3036826/scales/man/cscale.Rd:14: there is no package
called 'munsell'
Execution halted
Error: Command failed (1)

1) What's the most simple way of installing the devel version?
2) When can the CRAN version be expected to be updated?

Cheers,

Marius

PS: Mac OS X, 10.7.2, R 2.13.2

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: ggplot2 devel version installation: error
parts:
Hi Marius,

The problem is that scales requires 2.14 to build. Until it comes out
(today? tomorrow?) you can just use the version on CRAN.

Hadley
